title: The chief judge is murdered
summary: In the thirtieth year, they do not establish a king over the land, but they murder the chief judge.
characters: unidentified people who murder the chief judge

explicit_facts.text: They did not establish a king over the land.
In the thirtieth year, they murdered the chief judge of the land.
The account places the destruction upon the judgment seat.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The murder may be depicted as it happens, without showing wounds or blood.
unspecified_visual_details: The killers’ identities, number, appearance, and means of attack are not stated.
The judgment seat’s appearance and precise setting are not stated.

narration.text: they did destroy upon the judgment seat, yea, did murder the chief judge of the land.

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a king being established.
Do not assign identities or motives to the killers.
Do not invent weapons, wounds, blood, or dialogue.

title: The people divide into tribes
summary: The people separate into large tribes based on family, kindred, and friends, and each tribe appoints a leader.

explicit_facts.text: The people separated one from another into tribes according to family, kindred, and friends.
Each tribe appointed a chief or leader.
The tribes became exceedingly great because people had much family, kindred, and friends.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Separate clusters of people can represent the tribes, with a leader for each.
unspecified_visual_details: The leaders' identities, number, appearance, and the tribes' visual markers are unstated.

narration.text: they did separate one from another into tribes

prohibited_inventions: Do not give the tribes or their leaders invented names or biographies.

title: No wars yet
summary: The government regulations are destroyed amid contention; no wars have yet occurred, and few righteous men remain.

explicit_facts.text: There were no wars as yet among the people.
The government's regulations were destroyed because of the secret combination of the friends and kindreds of those who murdered the prophets.
Great contention came upon the land; few righteous men remained.
Less than six years had passed since most people turned from righteousness.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The people may be shown in opposing groups, without depicting warfare.
unspecified_visual_details: The precise form of the contention and any written regulations are not described.

narration.text: there were no wars as yet among them;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The comparisons in verse 8 are figures of speech, not literal events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict war or literal animals from the figures of speech.

title: Jacob is made king of the band
summary: The secret combination gathers, puts Jacob at its head, and calls him king over the wicked band.

explicit_facts.text: The secret combination gathered and placed Jacob at its head.
They called Jacob their king; he was one of the chiefest opponents of the prophets who testified of Jesus.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jacob may be shown with the gathered band as they recognize him as their leader.
unspecified_visual_details: The manner of gathering and making Jacob king, and any regalia, are not stated.

narration.text: they did call him their king;

prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a coronation, crown, or speech.

title: Jacob's band flees north
summary: Seeing that his enemies are more numerous, Jacob commands his band to flee to the northernmost part of the land, where they build a kingdom; their march takes them beyond the people's reach.
locations: the northernmost part of the land

explicit_facts.text: The tribes of the people were more numerous than Jacob's band.
Jacob commanded his people to flee to the northernmost part of the land and build a kingdom.
Their march was so speedy that they went beyond the people's reach; the thirtieth year ended.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Jacob's band can be shown traveling together toward the north.
unspecified_visual_details: The route, terrain, size of the band, and exact kingdom site are not described.

narration.text: they should take their flight into the northernmost part of the land,

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The dissenters Jacob expected to join them have not yet done so in this account.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict dissenters joining, a battle, or the creation of specific laws.

title: Tribes establish separate laws
summary: In the thirty-first year, the tribes agree not to war against one another and establish strict laws against trespass, though they are not united in government and stone and cast out prophets.

explicit_facts.text: In the thirty-first year, the people were divided into tribes and agreed not to war against one another.
Tribal laws and government differed; strict laws against trespass brought some degree of peace.
Their hearts were turned from the Lord; they stoned the prophets and cast them out.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A prophet being stoned and cast out may be depicted as the action described, without gore.
unspecified_visual_details: The number and identities of prophets, the specific place, and the tribes' laws are unstated.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a battle between tribes; the verse says they agreed not to go to war against one another.

title: Nephi testifies among the people
summary: Grieved by the people's return to wickedness, Nephi goes among them and testifies boldly of repentance and remission of sins through faith in Jesus Christ.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi had been visited by angels and the voice of the Lord, and was an eyewitness concerning Christ's ministry and the people's return to wickedness.
Nephi went among the people and boldly testified of repentance and remission of sins through faith on the Lord Jesus Christ.
Nephi ministered many things with power and great authority.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown addressing people gathered to hear him.
unspecified_visual_details: The precise setting, audience size, and most of Nephi's teachings are unstated.

narration.text: began to testify, boldly, repentance and remission of sins

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The account says many things Nephi ministered are not written; do not supply them.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show angels or the Lord appearing in this moment; their visit is reported in the narration.

title: People are angry with Nephi
summary: The people are angry with Nephi because of his greater power, though they cannot disbelieve his words; angels minister to him daily.

explicit_facts.text: The people were angry with Nephi because he had greater power than they.
They could not disbelieve his words; angels ministered to Nephi daily.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The people may be shown reacting angrily to Nephi.
unspecified_visual_details: The time and place of the daily angelic ministry, and the angels' appearance, are unstated.
doctrinal_or_story_notes: The daily ministry by angels is reported, but no specific visible angelic appearance is described here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict angels in this moment as though their appearance were specified.

title: The people witness his power
summary: A man raises his brother from the dead after the people have stoned him and he has died. The people see it and are angry with the man because of his power. He also performs many more miracles in their sight in the name of Jesus.

explicit_facts.text: He cast out devils and unclean spirits in the name of Jesus.
He raised his brother from the dead after the people had stoned the brother and he had died.
The people saw and witnessed it and were angry with him because of his power.
He performed many more miracles in the sight of the people in the name of Jesus.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The man, his brother, and witnesses may be shown at the raising, without depicting how it occurs.
The people's anger may be conveyed through their expressions.
unspecified_visual_details: The location, clothing, and appearances are not described.
The manner of the raising and the additional miracles are not described.

narration.text: even his brother did he raise from the dead, after he had been stoned and suffered death by the people.
And the people saw it, and did witness of it, and were angry with him because of his power;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The stoning preceded the raising; do not combine them into one moment.
The verses do not state that the casting out occurred in the people's sight.
prohibited_inventions: Do not name the man or his brother.
Do not depict wounds, blood, or supernatural visual effects.
Do not invent dialogue or specify the additional miracles.

title: Few are converted
summary: At the end of the thirty-first year, few are converted; those converted testify of God's power and Spirit, and healed people manifest their healing and show signs and miracles.
characters: people healed of sicknesses and infirmities

explicit_facts.text: Few were converted to the Lord during the thirty-first year.
The converted testified they had been visited by God's power and Spirit, which was in Jesus Christ, in whom they believed.
Those freed from devils and healed of sicknesses and infirmities manifested their healing and showed signs and miracles among the people.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The converted and healed may be shown bearing witness among other people.
unspecified_visual_details: The particular healings, signs, miracles, and manner of testimony are not specified.

narration.text: there were but few who were converted unto the Lord;

prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a specific healing or sign not described by the text.

title: Nephi preaches repentance
summary: At the beginning of the thirty-third year, Nephi cries to the people and preaches repentance and remission of sins.

explicit_facts.text: At the commencement of the thirty-third year, Nephi cried to the people and preached repentance and remission of sins.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown calling out to people as he preaches.
unspecified_visual_details: The place, audience size, and exact words of the sermon are unstated.

narration.text: he did preach unto them repentance and remission of sins.

prohibited_inventions: Do not turn the summarized sermon into invented dialogue.

title: Nephi ordains men to baptize
summary: Repentant people are baptized with water; Nephi ordains men to baptize those who come to them as a witness of repentance and remission of sins.

explicit_facts.text: None were brought to repentance who were not baptized with water.
Nephi ordained men to baptize those who came to them, as a witness and testimony before God and the people of repentance and remission of sins.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown ordaining men for the described ministry.
unspecified_visual_details: The manner of ordination and baptism, and the place, are not specified.

narration.text: there were ordained of Nephi, men unto this ministry,

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The verses state a relationship between repentance and water baptism; do not add further doctrinal claims.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a baptism ceremony here as a separately narrated event.

title: Many are baptized
summary: Many are baptized unto repentance at the beginning of the thirty-third year, and more of the year passes.

explicit_facts.text: Many were baptized unto repentance at the commencement of the thirty-third year.
More of the year passed away.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A water baptism may be depicted, as baptism is explicitly stated.
unspecified_visual_details: The people baptized, officiants, number, and location are not identified.

narration.text: there were many in the commencement of this year that were baptized unto repentance;

prohibited_inventions: Do not assign names or personal histories to those baptized.
